title: Studio1 deck outline
description: deck/outline.json: the source of truth for a pitch deck. The PDF and the editable PowerPoint are both built from it.

company.description: The company the deck is for.

date.description: Shown on the cover, for example 27 November 2026.

kind.description: Picks the layout. cover is the sunrise panel, proof is up to three cards, section is a dark divider.

purpose.description: Why the slide exists, in one line.

headline.description: The sentence on the slide, final words.

body.description: The few lines under the headline, verbatim.

source.description: Brief section or studio1-context file that backs the claim.

proof.description: Claims with their sources. A proof slide shows each as a card.

visual.description: What the eye sees: screenshot, diagram, number, quote.
